answer.reason: The verses tell of several deeds of the angel of the LORD, and the chief ones can be stated from them.

clauses.english: found Hagar by a fountain in the wilderness and told her to return to Sarai
clauses.quote: the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness

clauses.english: called to Abraham out of heaven and stopped him from slaying Isaac
clauses.quote: the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven

clauses.english: appeared to Moses in a flame of fire out of a bush
clauses.quote: the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire

clauses.english: smote 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians in one night
clauses.quote: smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand

doubts: Several marked verses speak of 'the angel of God' or 'an angel of the LORD' (GEN 21:17, GEN 31:11, EXO 14:19, JDG 6:11, JDG 13), so the record may merge more than one appearance.

The Psalms, Zechariah and the New Testament verses may concern other angels or figures of speech, so I left them out; the same goes for Balaam, Gideon, Manoah, the plague on Israel and Elijah, which were omitted only for brevity.
